agent_notes: The official identity is established on nimt.ac.in: the institution page labels it “NIMT College of Law (Formerly NIMT Technical and Professional College), Kotputli Jaipur” and gives the SP-3-1, RIICO Industrial Area, Keshwana, Kotputli, District Jaipur, Rajasthan 303108 address.

The official institution page says it is currently offering five programmes: B.A., B.Sc, B.Com, LLB, and BA-LLB. The central official catalogue currently exposes a Kotputli-specific LLB page but does not expose Kotputli-specific catalogue pages for B.A., B.Sc, B.Com, or BA-LLB; the institution page and central catalogue are therefore not synchronized, so manual review is required.
The central catalogue also lists other Kotputli-campus programmes belonging to co-located institutions, so those were not attributed to NIMT Technical and Professional College.

Normal TLS verification first failed with the exact managed proxy error “self signed certificate in certificate chain”; curl --insecure was then used only for public GET requests to the expected official/search hostnames.

The official Kotputli LLB page contains unrelated generic healthcare copy in parts of the page; only its explicit law title, Kotputli location, duration, eligibility, full-time mode, and BCI statements were used.
